publication_note: Compact historical baseline. Raw CSVs, logs, binaries, and modified dependency snapshots are not distributed. Hashes identify the measured inputs and captures; checking out the dependency base commits alone does not recreate those inputs. Paths in recorded commands are normalized placeholders, not bundled artifacts.
measurement_notes: CPU wall time; no GPU execution timestamps or input-to-photon latency.
Frame trials: 1320 frames per process, first 120 warmup, 1200 measured; three serial trials, rotated scenario order.
CPU suites: five serial process trials pinned to CPU 0, seven calibrated approximately 35-40 ms batch means per case (geometry targets 40 ms).
Compiler comparison before=GCC 13.3.0, after=Clang 18.1.3; not a before/after source optimization.
Buffer comparisons rotate 1/2/3, 2/3/1, 3/1/2 configurations over three rounds, immediate presentation.
Lifecycle A/A uses the same final executable on both sides; it validates the comparison runner, not a speedup.
Independent benchmark overlap captures were archived and excluded. Normal desktop processes and balanced CPU power policy remain active.
Per-trial ranges are observations, not confidence intervals. The measured dependency working copies differ from their base commits; hashes identify those historical snapshots.
Native Wayland, extended HiDPI, cross-application clipboard/IME composition, Windows execution, and hardware performance counters were not validated here.
Presentation modes ran in separate consecutive blocks; compare small differences cautiously because desktop load and CPU frequency varied.
perf hardware counters were unavailable under perf_event_paranoid=4; no system power or profiling-permission settings were changed.

later_public_dependency_match.scope: The dependency headers included by these GUI builds match these later public commits. The historical snapshots and original base commits above remain the measured provenance.
later_public_dependency_match.unused_snapshot_difference: rg_text/src/rg_text_gpu.h differs from the later public commit; it is not included by the measured rg_gui sources, demos, tests, or CPU benchmarks.
